player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm ad tili Player {player_id} di JoJoJoin, yurar ɣef ussna 5x5 s yicellan izalan 0-24.
Di turk, sers imark-nnek ɣef yicellan yimɣaren, amata '[12]'.
TIRIḌ ad ternuḍ RBAḤ kkiɣ ilalan n imark-nnek di lqed - kkuẓ icellan imɣaren s waḥil, s wadda, neɣ s tɣmert.
Akka Player {player_id} kcemm ad tili '{symbol}'; anembaḍ-nnek ɣ'ad yili '{opponent_symbol}'.
